title: Zombie Syringe
description: a syringe that can transfer zombie (husk,drowned) blood to villagers
body:
created for this mod request: [link](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/requests-ideas-for-mods/3228609-mod-makers-please)

it basically adds a syringe that can extract zombie essences from a zombie,husk and drowned and tranport that essence to a villager.

recipe of the syringe is 3 glass bottles and one iron nugget.
